changelog:
Initial release of the OpenSprinkler skill.

- Monitor and control an OpenSprinkler irrigation controller via its local HTTP API.
- Check current system status, view logs, and manage overall system operation.
- Run manual stations or programs, toggle rain delays, and pause irrigation queue.
- Supports checking rain sensor status, weather-based watering levels, and retrieving diagnostics.
- Requires specifying IP address and password for secure device connection.
summary: Monitor and control an OpenSprinkler irrigation controller. Enables checking status, running manual stations/programs, toggling rain delays, viewing logs, and pausing the queue via AI-friendly JSON formatting and 1-based station indexing—with no dangerous system commands.
